lead.headline: Paradigm Expands Mandate with $1.2B Fund
lead.tldr: The launch of Paradigm's fourth fund signals a strategic pivot from pure-play crypto to a broader 'frontier tech' thesis encompassing AI and robotics.

intro: Dear Founders, Investors, and Friends, here is what moved in Web3 over the last 24 hours and why it matters for the quarter ahead.

top_signals.title: Announcing Our Fourth Fund
top_signals.summary: Paradigm has announced the launch of its fourth fund, raising $1.2 billion. The capital is intended to support ambitious builders working at the frontier of technology and Web3.
top_signals.why_it_matters: A $1.2B war chest provides significant dry powder for late-stage frontier tech bets.

top_signals.title: Crypto VC Paradigm raises $1.2B to push into AICrypto venture firm Paradigm is widening its investment gaze toward AI and other frontier industries with its latest fund.
top_signals.summary: Crypto venture capital firm Paradigm has raised a new fund totaling $1.2 billion. The firm intends to use this capital to expand its investment focus into AI and other frontier technology industries.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Paradigm's move into AI suggests a convergence of compute and cryptography as a primary investment thesis.

top_signals.title: Paradigm raises $1.2 billion fourth fund, expanding beyond crypto into AI and robotics
top_signals.summary: Crypto venture capital firm Paradigm has launched its fourth fund with $1.2 billion in capital. The firm is expanding its investment mandate beyond blockchain to include AI and robotics startups.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The explicit inclusion of robotics indicates a shift toward physical-world applications of decentralized logic.

top_signals.title: Tokenized stock transfers surge 105% in a month to $8.4B22m, Tokenized stock transfers surge 105% in a month to $8.4BIndustry data shows trading activity and market value accelerating as crypto companies and traditional financial institutions expand tokenized equity initiatives.
top_signals.summary: Tokenized stock transfers experienced a massive 105% surge in a single month, reaching a total value of $8.4 billion. This growth is driven by the expanding initiatives of both crypto-native companies and traditional financial institutions.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The 105% surge in tokenized stock transfers validates the transition of RWA from conceptual pilots to high-volume liquidity.

top_signals.title: Officials set to revise MiCA to cover non-EU stablecoin issuers: Report15m, Officials set to revise MiCA to cover non-EU stablecoin issuers: ReportEU officials reportedly plan to consider changes to the Markets in Crypto-Assets framework, dubbed by some as “MiCA 2.0,” in response to a US stablecoin law and rules on tokenized payments and deposits.
top_signals.summary: EU officials are reportedly planning revisions to the Markets in Crypto-Assets (MiCA) framework, potentially termed 'MiCA 2.0'. These updates aim to address non-EU stablecoin issuers and align with emerging US stablecoin laws and tokenized payment regulations.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Potential MiCA 2.0 revisions suggest the EU is prioritizing regulatory interoperability with US stablecoin frameworks.

on_the_radar.title: Stablecoin-settled TradFi perpetual trading tops $1.1T: Binance Research34m
on_the_radar.summary: Binance Research reports that stablecoin-settled traditional finance (TradFi) perpetual trading has surpassed $1.1 trillion. This highlights the growing adoption of digital assets for settling complex financial derivatives.

on_the_radar.title: European Commission looks to expand MiCA to cover emergence of tokenization, non-EU stablecoin issuers: report
on_the_radar.summary: The European Commission is seeking stakeholder feedback on expanding the Markets in Crypto-Assets (MiCA) framework. The proposed expansion aims to cover the growth of tokenization and the activities of non-EU stablecoin issuers.

on_the_radar.title: Kazakhstan president signs decree to accelerate crypto adoption9m, Kazakhstan president signs decree to accelerate crypto adoptionKazakhstan targets gas-powered electricity for mining, income tax exemptions for regulated crypto transactions and cross-border stablecoin payments in a new decree signed by the president.
on_the_radar.summary: The President of Kazakhstan has signed a decree aimed at accelerating the adoption of cryptocurrency within the country. The initiative focuses on leveraging gas-powered electricity for mining and implementing tax exemptions for regulated transactions.

on_the_radar.title: BNB Chain builds new Layer 1 for agentic trading, targets 2027 mainnet
on_the_radar.summary: BNB Chain is developing a new Layer 1 blockchain specifically designed for agentic trading. The network aims for sub-50ms preconfirmations and will feature no public mempool to enhance trading efficiency.

on_the_radar.title: ESMA turns spotlight on crypto custody risks after MiCA transition35m, ESMA turns spotlight on crypto custody risks after MiCA transitionThe EU securities regulator will assess custody providers’ key management, incident response and reliance on third-party technology providers.
on_the_radar.summary: The European Securities and Markets Authority (ESMA) is intensifying its scrutiny of crypto custody providers following the transition to MiCA regulations. The regulator will specifically evaluate key management, incident response protocols, and the risks associated with third-party technology dependencies.

on_the_radar.title: India central bank seeks to bar financial institutions from exposure to crypto assets: Reuters
on_the_radar.summary: The Reserve Bank of India is seeking to prohibit financial institutions from having exposure to crypto assets. This move reflects the central bank's ongoing push for tighter restrictions on digital assets within the country.

on_the_radar.title: Berachain hard fork to replace dual-token model with WBERA rewards32m, Berachain hard fork to replace dual-token model with WBERA rewardsBerachain launched the first stage of its PoL Next upgrade, which will phase out the BGT token and shift the network's reward system to WBERA.
on_the_radar.summary: Berachain has initiated the first stage of its PoL Next upgrade, which involves a hard fork to modify its tokenomics. The network is phasing out the BGT token in favor of a reward system based on WBERA.

on_the_radar.title: Tom Lee's Bitmine adds $70 million worth of ETH to treasury: onchain analyst
on_the_radar.summary: Bitmine, associated with Tom Lee, has significantly increased its Ethereum holdings, adding $70 million worth of ETH to its treasury. The company now holds 5.74 million ETH, representing approximately 4.8% of the total circulating supply.

linkedin_post: Paradigm raising $1.2 billion for its fourth fund is a clear signal that the boundary between 'crypto' and 'frontier tech' has effectively vanished. What I keep coming back to is the specific inclusion of robotics and AI in their mandate. This isn't a hedge; it's a recognition that the most valuable future systems will likely integrate decentralized coordination with autonomous physical agents. When a firm of Paradigm's scale pivots its mandate, it usually reflects a shift in where the most aggressive capital sees the next cycle of value capture. I'd watch how this affects valuation benchmarks for AI-crypto hybrids, as the availability of this much dedicated capital will likely inflate premiums for teams building at that intersection. #Paradigm #AI #Robotics
